body.intent: AGENTS.md is this repo's agent entry point: CLAUDE.md's guidance moves into AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md becomes an @AGENTS.md import, AGENTS.md links agents/README.md (the index of agents/ docs), a Go test keeps the index and relative links consistent, and the tests and capabilities that read CLAUDE.md read AGENTS.md
body.title: AGENTS.md entry point
